title: Estate record (estate-record/1)
description: DEC-0055: one revision of one person's estate — the passkeys that sign it, the machines with their device keys and a certificate of each hub key, the packages placed per machine and context (DEC-0082), secret placements by reference, share grants and revocations. Each revision names its parent's digest and is signed by a passkey assertion (WebAuthn Level 3) over a challenge derived from its digest. The digest is SHA-256 over RFC 8785 of this document without digest and signature. docs/specification/estate-record.md.

estate.description: The estate's opaque id, the same in every revision (FAC-SEM-072). Never a person's name or address.

revision.description: 1 for the first revision; each later one is its parent's plus one (FAC-SEM-072). A machine's report to its hub names it in records.estateRecord.revision (DEC-0053, DEC-0128).

parent.description: The parent revision's digest; absent exactly in revision 1.

validUntil.description: At most 30 days after issuedAt (the first organization server's target architecture v4 §7, Freshness; FAC-SEM-072).

authorities.description: The passkeys that may sign the next revision. Revision 1 is signed by one the enrolling machine pinned; every later revision by one its parent lists (key continuity).

publisherKeys.description: The publisher keys the estate's machines pin, by kid: a placement names one, and verifyPackage verifies the placed package's publisher signature under it (DEC-0051).

publisherScopes.description: DEC-0090: the publisher keys that are a partner's, each trusted only for placements in the organization contexts it names (FAC-SEM-122). A key not named here keeps DEC-0051's meaning.

shareGrants.description: Share grants (DEC-0037, DEC-0039): standing grants to a person or organization outside the estate, each a delegation grant with an audience. A share grant into an organization carries its context, org:<orgId>, never personal (DEC-0082, FAC-SEM-110); an instance placed in that context names it (FAC-SEM-111).

organizations.description: The organizations the person admitted into their estate (DEC-0127 OM-2), each by its context, its server and the root key that signs its org-key-set/1: the estate's half of the organization-to-estate mapping. The passkey's signature over the revision is the person's admission (R1-D12); no administrator signs it. Each org once (FAC-SEM-147). A reader pinned before DEC-0127 refuses the member, so Fabric writes it only once every reader of the record is pinned at or after.

deltaAnchor.description: DEC-0107: the revocation delta's head this revision vouches for, in the shape a machine reports it (records.revocationDelta). Every revocation of the entries up to it is in this record (reconciliation, DEC-0054), so a machine that does not hold those entries starts its chain here (anchorDelta) instead of verifying entries an estate key the record no longer certifies signed. Never moves back (FAC-SEM-137).

revocations.description: Every revocation of this estate so far: a revision keeps its parent's (FAC-SEM-072), and lists nothing it revokes (FAC-SEM-076).

digest.description: SHA-256 over the RFC 8785 form of this document without digest and signature (DEC-0043, DEC-0055).

credentialId.description: The WebAuthn credential id, as the authenticator returned it. No user handle is recorded.

alg.description: The credential's algorithm: ES256 is COSE -7, EdDSA is COSE -8 with Ed25519.

publicKey.description: The credential public key as a public JWK: a P-256 point valid by SEC 1 §3.2.2, or an Ed25519 key not of small order (FAC-SEM-073).

rpId.description: The RP ID of the dedicated signing credential: sign.<domain>, never the sign-in one (DEC-0063, FAC-SEM-092); every pinned origin is on it or a host under it.

origins.description: The pinned origins a signing ceremony may run in; clientDataJSON.origin is one of them.

edKey.description: A public Ed25519 JWK naming its alg (EdDSA), as the estate's key set publishes it (DEC-0039); ES256 joins when Fabric records its decision D2.

id.description: The machine's own opaque id in the estate, never an organization enrollment's device.id (DEC-0128 UE-1); no human name.

deviceKeys.description: DEC-0053's device keys by role: exactly one <id>#sig, and at most one <id>#kem (FAC-SEM-073).

hubKey.description: The certificate of the hub key on this machine: the passkey-signed record binds this kid and public key to this machine. A delegation verifier that reads the record trusts a token's kid only while the revision it reads certifies it: one it verified and the highest its machine applied (delegation.md DL-14, hubKeyCertified, DEC-0060).

contextHubKeys.description: The hub keys of this machine per organization context (DEC-0128): each signs the delegation tokens of its context under that context's iss, and nothing of the estate's (heartbeats, delta entries, leases stay the personal hubKey's). Each context once, every kid and key unique across all hub keys of the record, the context pinned in organizations, only on a full machine that holds the personal hubKey (FAC-SEM-073, FAC-SEM-134). A reader pinned before DEC-0128 refuses the member, so Fabric writes it only once every reader of the record is pinned at or after.

publisherKid.description: The publisher key, in publisherKeys, its publisher signature verifies under.

context.description: DEC-0082: the context this instance runs in; absent means personal. An agent is placed once per machine and context (FAC-SEM-074), so one agent may run on one machine as a personal instance and as an instance in each organization it is shared into.

grant.description: DEC-0082: the share grant this instance runs under, by its meta.id. Named exactly when the context is org:<orgId>: a grant of this record's shareGrants, matched by normal form (DEC-0076), whose context is the placement's, not revoked by the record (FAC-SEM-111). A personal placement names none.

slot.description: The package's secret slot by name (DEC-0050 secrets[]). A reference, never a value (DEC-0013, FAC-SEM-075).

from.description: The machine, in this record, whose vault holds the slot; the value travels sealed to this machine's #kem key, never in the record.

context.description: DEC-0082: the context of the placed instance whose slot this fills; absent means personal. A slot is placed once per agent and context (FAC-SEM-075).

secrets.description: Secret placements: where a slot of a package placed here is filled from, for the instance of that agent in a context (DEC-0082). No member can hold a value.

profile.description: DEC-0106: what this machine may be. Absent means full, and a writer omits full. member: takes T1 calls, carries no hubKey, holds a placed package's secrets only in the slots the record places on it, every placement by a revision, and the credentials a credential envelope delivers to it (DEC-0111, credentials.md). view: no hubKey, no placement, no secret placement and the source of none; a call it makes or receives only reads. Changed only by a revision the passkey signs (FAC-SEM-134).

ref.description: What is revoked, in its kind's own form: a credential id, a machine id, a kid, a package digest or a grant's meta.id. A device-key revocation names a kid (every key ever listed under it) or one key's reference <kid>@sha256:<hex of its octets> (DEC-0084, FAC-SEM-076).

sig.description: ES256: an ASN.1 DER Ecdsa-Sig-Value (WebAuthn Level 3 §6.5.5, RFC 3279 §2.2.3); EdDSA: the 64-byte Ed25519 signature.

assertion.description: A WebAuthn Level 3 assertion response, without the user handle: the passkey signed authenticatorData ‖ SHA-256(clientDataJSON), and clientDataJSON's challenge is derived from the record's digest (estateChallenge).

partner.description: The partner organization that holds the key, org:<partnerOrgId>, an ordinary organization id (the first organization server's PA-01).

contexts.description: The organization contexts a placement under this key may be in; never personal.

issuer.description: The organization server's origin, as its attestations name it.

iss.description: The delegation issuer of this organization's context (DEC-0128): an opaque id per (estate, organization), stable across key rotation and hub moves, never containing the estate id, so a token in this context names no estate. Each pin's own (FAC-SEM-147).

root.description: The organization's root (Ed25519): it signs org-key-set/1 documents only. Never of small order (FAC-SEM-147, DEC-0045).

pinnedAt.description: When the person admitted the organization.

contextHubKey.description: One organization context's hub key on a machine (DEC-0128).
